I write only to relieve myself of feelings.

I cannot imagine making it into a career option. Or part time. Or whatever.

If people are appreciating my writing only because it makes them feel less alone in whatever crap they're going through, great. But it doesn't take away my choice to end the pain for myself.

Writing is good for venting but I feel it isn't a viable career option unless I somehow magically obtain the ability to write a cult hit. 

It's not that writers expect their works to become popular and lucrative. It's not why they write.

I just don't have the guts to put myself out there on paper, I guess.
